svg.text: UI conventions — trees, label-first forms, collapsing headers (house style; DESIGN_UI_Conventions.md)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
① Trees — one chevron, drawn BEFORE the icon
AFTER · every tree: CHEVRON · ICON · LABEL
One shape: ImGui's own tree arrow (what TreeNodeEx draws) — the ORBAT's framed ArrowButton goes.
A leaf keeps the chevron's slot, so every label at one depth starts at one x. The icon is painted
after the arrow, the same way the icon tabs paint theirs (Colour Icons §3.1).
② Forms — the label first, every control in the second column
TODAY · ImGui's default (Director window): control first, label after
The eye scans ragged edges: controls at the left, labels trailing at varying x,
checkbox labels at a third x.
AFTER · label-first (the Details forms' row, house-wide)
Column 1 = the widest label (measured once, cached), column 2 = the controls at ONE x and ONE width.
A checkbox in a form sits in column 2 with no text after it. A checkbox that is a toolbar option
(the asset browser's kind chips) keeps ImGui's text-after-box — it is not a form row (Q3).
③ Collapsing headers — slate with a coloured icon; blue stays for SELECTION
TODAY · headers, buttons, frames, selection — all the same blue
AFTER · slate header, CHEVRON · coloured ICON · LABEL
Slate base #2B2F38, hover #353A45, active #3F4552 — pushed by the one header helper, never globally:
ImGuiCol.Header is ALSO the selection colour of every Selectable and tree row, so a global change
would grey out selection. The raw editor's authority-green component header keeps its meaning (Q5).
Measured: no theme is set anywhere (no StyleColors* call in Hrot/ or FDP/ engine code) — this is
ImGui's default dark, where Header, Button, FrameBg, Tab and TitleBg are all the same hue.
